summary: OPENLANE, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiaries Automotive Finance Corporation and AFC Funding Corporation entered a Second Amendment to the Tenth Amended and Restated Receivables Purchase Agreement, and that Automotive Finance Canada Inc. and the Company entered Amendment No. 4 to a Canadian receivables purchase agreement. Both amendments extend facility termination dates from January 31, 2028 to January 31, 2030, effective September 25, 2026. Lender groups include BMO, PNC, Truist, JPMorgan, RBC and others; full texts will be filed with the Q3 2026 10-Q. This is a routine securitization credit-facility extension, not a special situation; no deal risk-arb angle applies.
